about: Every input of mapping release 1.3 (crew_mapping.py release-13), pinned by hash like release-large-pins.json. The crew side is that of release 1.2 (the recipe of Missions dataset release 1.1 holds the crew references), the participants are those of Missions dataset release 1.2 (participants.json, each reference with its class P or O), and the target is the manifest of the large Personnel v2 snapshot. A run refuses to start when a pin differs; the release repeats the pins in crew.json and participants.json. Changing a pin is a deliberate act: python -B federation/personnel-mapping/crew_mapping.py pins --write --pins-file federation/personnel-mapping/release-1-3-pins.json.
